maestro.cash: returned from selected festival site with Borga, Harn and land official

festival.status: concept approved by Carrion; main site selected

site.choice: third inspected site south of capital
features: space for separate stage, tournament area, trade/crafts and traveler camp

layout_concept.stage_use: Arlequino 12:00-17:00; otherwise open to local and visiting artists if they agree, with no guaranteed pay
layout_concept.tournament_area_use: official tournament when scheduled; otherwise free training by masters, demonstrations and friendly bouts

festival.timing: about one month from T+130; exact opening date not yet fixed
festival.organizer: Rena is independently searching for a competent female organizer in Eurazania; after one is chosen, Arlequino plans another full site walk and then exact date approval

tournament_concept.expected_scale: possibly 200-300+ after preliminary admission; exact number unknown
tournament_concept.days_1_2: mass team elimination; day 1 on firm ground, day 2 at a safe shallow ford if verified
tournament_concept.elimination_rule: each mass stage has a predetermined threshold of remaining combat-capable participants; surrender, unconsciousness or judge stoppage counts as eliminated
tournament_concept.day_3: flexible; repeat or intensify mass-stage conditions if too many remain
tournament_concept.day_4: surviving tournament participants in temporary groups face experienced cohesive units, with individual assessment rather than automatic group elimination
tournament_concept.days_5_6: individual combat phase under rules Borga will design and test
tournament_concept.day_7: semifinals/final; proposed prize includes money from Arlequino and, only if Carrion separately agrees, the official right to publicly challenge Carrion
tournament_concept.Borga_role: willing to handle combat rules, admissions, judges, testing and tournament design; not general festival organizer

local_announcement.plan: Arlequino wants a public concert in Borga's large training yard to announce the festival to Eurazania
local_announcement.Borga: large yard can likely be made available toward evening after training if nothing changes
local_announcement.name: festival name not fixed; Arlequino prefers to have Carrion approve it
